Market Overview & Long-Term Price Trend

Gold's trajectory from 2000 to 2025 reveals distinct phases:

  • 2000-2008: Gradual appreciation from ~$274 to ~$870, with the 2008 financial crisis driving safe-haven flows
  • 2008-2011: Sharp rally from $870 to ~$1,900 during the global financial crisis and subsequent monetary easing
  • 2011-2015: Correction phase, declining from ~$1,900 to ~$1,050 as the Fed began tapering
  • 2015-2019: Consolidation period, oscillating between $1,050-$1,350
  • 2019-2025: New bull market, driven by pandemic monetary stimulus, inflation concerns, and geopolitical risks, reaching new ATH above $4,500

Risk Management Implications

  • Geopolitical tensions and macro uncertainty typically support gold prices
